name: 中華鷓鴣
illustrationTaxon: Francolinus pintadeanus adult male; main image and four diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 鵪鶉體型小得多（17–19 cm），雄鳥紅褐臉喉、奶油色眉紋及暗冠，胸脇偏淡褐而非白點密布。中華鷓鴣約31–34 cm，雄鳥頭部黑白斑紋及黑底白點身體明顯。
灰胸竹雞胸前有灰藍色胸帶、栗色喉臉及黃褐底黑斑脅部；中華鷓鴣雄鳥則有白頰白喉、黑色面紋及栗色冠側，胸脇黑底白點。

featureNotes: 雄鳥頭紋醒目，黑色面紋框住白頰，冠側帶栗色
白色頰喉與黑色貫眼、頰下紋形成明顯對比
頸胸與脇部黑底密布大型白點，肩羽帶栗色
粗壯短腿呈黃橙色；全身為細緻黑白斑駁羽紋

sources.use: Full HKBWS Chinese Francolin account read: localised resident of grass-dominated hillsides/open-canopy shrubland; 31–34 cm (source text has reversed '31-24 cm' typo but subsequent distinction and field use support the corrected conventional 31–34 cm); male black pattern surrounding white cheeks, rusty-brown crown sides, white-spotted dark neck/breast/flanks; female duller with barred buff underparts and no chestnut wing patch; yellowish-orange legs. HKBWS describes a substantial local decline in distribution attributed to vegetation succession; global IUCN LC/stable is separately labelled from Hong Kong local status. Broad range from northeast India via mainland Southeast Asia to southern China.

Cornell eBird species account: male white cheeks and rufous crown/shoulders/vent with black-white scaling; female similar but browner and less bright. Used to cross-check male illustration and sex designation.

Full HKBWS Japanese Quail account read: 17–19 cm; adult male rufous face/throat, broad creamy supercilium, dark crown and buff chest/flanks; female duller with dark breast mottling. Hong Kong scarce autumn migrant, rare winter/spring migrant; global IUCN Near Threatened. Used as a size/plumage comparison, not to conflate its local passage status with the main species.

Cornell eBird Chinese Bamboo-Partridge account: characteristic grey-blue brow/chest, orange cheeks and breast band, and large black flank spots; used as a clearly named local galliform comparison, adult male.
